author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am back to present my new DTC and DTM map, Vallotrix.

It is my first and probably last attempt at a diagonal map instead of a straight forward one.

Map Information

Time Limit: According to when the core changes
Team Sizes: 16v16
Team Colours: Cyan and Yellow
Inventory: Stone Sword, Infinity Bow, 1 arrow, Efficiency 1 Diamond Pickaxe, 4 Bottles o' Enchanting, 64 Steak, 64 Glass, 64 Prismarine, 4 Golden Apples.

Technical stuff...

Server Hosted: alexanderjoe /mvtp Number12
Download: TBC
XML: TBC

Album: http://imgur.com/a/WH8MG

I appreciate all who view it and give feedback.

Thank you,

Myv
